# Pac UI

> Pac UI is a set of type-safe, customizable form components for React, built on react-hook-form and Zod. A FormProvider and a small family of Form* field components handle validation, error display, and accessibility for you.

Pac UI is built on top of shadcn/ui with the same design principles: copy the components into your project, own the code, and customize freely. It uses Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. Components are installed individually using the shadcn CLI.

## Table of Contents

- [Installation](#installation)

## Components

import { generateMetadata } from "../utils/metadata"

export const metadata = generateMetadata(
  "Introduction",
  "Introduction to Pac UI."
)

**Pac UI** is a set of type-safe, customizable form components for React, built on [react-hook-form](https://react-hook-form.com/) and [Zod](https://zod.dev/). A `FormProvider` and a small family of `Form*` field components handle validation, error display, and accessibility for you, so building a form is mostly just describing its shape.

**Pac UI** is built on top of shadcn/ui with the same design principles: copy the components into your project, own the code, and customize freely.

This project is a work in progress, and we're continuously improving and expanding the collection. We'd love to hear your feedback or see your contributions as it evolves!

Head to [Form](/docs/form) to see how the pieces fit together.


import { generateMetadata } from "../utils/metadata"

export const metadata = generateMetadata(

# Installation

## Prerequisites

Before installing, ensure you have the following:

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download/) version **18** or later
- [React](https://react.dev/) version **19** or later

## Install shadcn/ui

First, you'll need to install and configure shadcn/ui in your project. Follow the installation guide at [shadcn/ui documentation](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/installation).

Once shadcn/ui is set up, you can install **Pac UI** components using the **shadcn CLI**.

## Using the shadcn CLI

<CodeBlock
  language="bash"
  code={`npx shadcn@latest add "https://pac.chandresh.dev/c/[COMPONENT].json"`}
/>

## Usage

After installation, import and start using the components in your project:

<CodeBlock
  language="tsx"
  code={`import { FormProvider } from "@/components/form/form-provider";
import { FormInput } from "@/components/form/form-input";`}
/>

See [Form](/docs/form) for the full pattern: a Zod schema, `useForm`, `FormProvider`, and the field components.

# Attribution

**Pac UI** started as a fork of [**prompt-kit**](https://github.com/ibelick/prompt-kit), the excellent AI chat component library built by [Julien Thibeaut](https://twitter.com/ibelick). The overall site layout, docs structure, and general project scaffolding you see here trace directly back to prompt-kit — we're grateful for that foundation and want to be upfront about it.

## What came from prompt-kit

- The site layout, navigation, and docs structure.
- The overall project scaffolding (build tooling, MDX docs setup, registry pattern).
- The general approach of "copy the component into your project, own the code" popularized by prompt-kit and shadcn/ui.

## What's original to Pac UI

- Every component in this library — the `FormProvider` and all `Form*` field components — is original work, written from scratch for type-safe forms. None of it is copied from prompt-kit.
- Pac UI solves a different problem entirely: prompt-kit is built for AI chat interfaces, while Pac UI is built for validated, type-safe forms on top of react-hook-form and Zod.

## Thank you

Huge thanks to Julien Thibeaut and everyone who has contributed to prompt-kit. It's a fantastic project, and Pac UI wouldn't look the way it does without it. If you're building an AI chat interface, go check out [prompt-kit](https://github.com/ibelick/prompt-kit) — it's a great library and deserves the support.

Pac UI is maintained by Chandresh Patidar, who joined as a new contributor to build out the form-focused component set on top of the prompt-kit foundation.

Both projects are MIT licensed. See the `LICENCE.md` file in the repository for the full copyright notice.

# Form

The form system pairs [react-hook-form](https://react-hook-form.com/) for state management with [Zod](https://zod.dev/) for validation, and wraps both behind a small set of components so you rarely touch either library directly.

## Example

<ComponentCodePreview
  component={<FormBasic />}
  filePath="app/docs/form/form-basic.tsx"
  classNameComponentContainer="p-8"
/>

## Why a FormProvider?

Without it, every field needs `value`, `onChange`, and an error to be threaded down manually — and every parent in between has to know about props it never uses just to pass them along. That's prop drilling, and it gets worse as a form grows past two or three fields.

`FormProvider` avoids this by wrapping react-hook-form's own `FormProvider` and handing the form's `control` object down through React context instead:

```tsx
<FormProvider methods={form} onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
  {/* any Form* field can read `control` from context if you don't pass it explicitly */}
</FormProvider>
```

Every `Form*` component (`FormInput`, `FormSelect`, `FormCheckbox`, and so on) binds itself to a single field with react-hook-form's `Controller`, using the `control` and `name` props you give it:

```tsx
<Controller
  control={control}
  name={name}
  render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
    // field.value / field.onChange / field.onBlur wire the input;
    // fieldState.error is whatever Zod produced for this field, if anything
  )}
/>
```

Because `Controller` subscribes only to its own field, adding a tenth field to a form doesn't mean threading ten more props through components that don't care about them — each field component asks react-hook-form for its own slice of state directly.

## Validation and error handling

A Zod schema is the single source of truth for what a form's data should look like:

```tsx
const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Invalid email format"),
  password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
})

const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof schema>>({
  resolver: zodResolver(schema),
})
```

`zodResolver` runs that schema on every submit (and, once a field has been touched, on every change) and turns any failure into a `fieldState.error` for the matching field. Every `Form*` component already renders that error through `FieldError` — you don't write `{errors.email && <p>...</p>}` next to each input. If validation passes, `onSubmit` never even runs with bad data.

## Types flow from the schema

`z.infer<typeof schema>` gives you the exact shape of validated data, and that type flows all the way through:

```tsx
type LoginFormValues = z.infer<typeof schema>

const form = useForm<LoginFormValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) })

<FormInput control={form.control} name="email" />
```

`FormInput`'s `name` prop is typed as `FieldPath<TFieldValues>` — a union of every valid key path in `LoginFormValues` — so `name="email"` autocompletes and `name="emial"` is a compile error, not a runtime one. Rename a field in the schema and every call site that references the old name stops compiling until you fix it.

## Field components

- [Input](/docs/form-input) — single-line text input
- [Password](/docs/form-password) — password input with a show/hide toggle
- [Textarea](/docs/form-textarea) — multi-line text input
- [Select](/docs/form-select) — single-choice dropdown
- [Checkbox](/docs/form-checkbox) — single boolean toggle, checkbox style
- [Switch](/docs/form-switch) — single boolean toggle, switch style
- [Date Picker](/docs/form-date-picker) — text input with a calendar popover
- [Number Field](/docs/form-number-field) — numeric input with increment/decrement
- [Phone Number](/docs/form-phone-number) — phone input with a country selector
- [File](/docs/form-file) — drag-and-drop file upload
- [Array Field](/docs/form-array-field) — a repeatable list of inputs

## Component API

### FormProvider

| Prop      | Type                     | Description                                         |
| :-------- | :----------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------- |
| methods   | `UseFormReturn<T>`       | The object returned by react-hook-form's `useForm()` |
| onSubmit  | `() => void`             | Called with the validated values on submit           |
| className | string                   | Additional CSS classes on the `<form>` element        |
| children  | React.ReactNode          | The form's fields                                     |

## Component API

### FormInput

| Prop           | Type                | Description                                    |
| :------------- | :------------------ | :---------------------------------------------- |
| control         | `Control<T>`         | The `control` object from `useForm()`            |
| name            | `FieldPath<T>`       | The field name, type-checked against `T`         |
| label           | string               | Field label                                       |
| description     | string               | Helper text below the input                      |
| Icon            | React.ReactNode      | Leading icon                                     |
| inputClassName  | string               | Additional CSS classes on the `<input>`          |
| className       | string               | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper       |
| ...props        | `React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>` | All other native input props (`type`, `placeholder`, ...) |

## Component API

### FormSelect

| Prop              | Type                                       | Description                              |
| :----------------- | :------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------ |
| control             | `Control<T>`                                | The `control` object from `useForm()`        |
| name                | `FieldPath<T>`                              | The field name, type-checked against `T`     |
| label               | string                                       | Field label                                  |
| icon                | React.ReactNode                              | Icon rendered next to the label               |
| placeholder         | string                                       | Placeholder shown when no option is selected  |
| options             | `{ value: string; label: React.ReactNode }[]` | The selectable options                        |
| disabled            | boolean                                      | Disables the select                           |
| className           | string                                       | Additional CSS classes on the trigger          |
| formItemClassName   | string                                       | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper    |

## Component API

### FormNumberField

| Prop            | Type            | Description                                |
| :--------------- | :--------------- | :---------------------------------------------- |
| control           | `Control<T>`      | The `control` object from `useForm()`            |
| name              | `FieldPath<T>`    | The field name, type-checked against `T`         |
| label             | string            | Field label                                       |
| description       | string            | Helper text below the input                      |
| Icon              | React.ReactNode   | Leading icon                                     |
| showButtons       | boolean           | Whether to show the increment/decrement buttons (default: `true`) |
| min               | number            | Minimum allowed value                             |
| max               | number            | Maximum allowed value                             |
| step              | number \| string  | Increment step                                    |
| inputClassName    | string            | Additional CSS classes on the number input        |
| className         | string            | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper        |

## Component API

### FormPhoneNumber

| Prop               | Type            | Description                             |
| :------------------ | :--------------- | :------------------------------------------ |
| control              | `Control<T>`      | The `control` object from `useForm()`        |
| name                 | `FieldPath<T>`    | The field name, type-checked against `T`     |
| label                | string            | Field label                                  |
| placeholder          | string            | Placeholder text                             |
| disabled             | boolean           | Disables the input                           |
| formItemClassName    | string            | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper   |


import ComponentCodePreview from "@/components/app/component-code-preview"

export const metadata = generateMetadata(
  "Form File",
  "A drag-and-drop file upload bound to react-hook-form, with automatic error display."
)

# Form File

A drag-and-drop file upload bound to a [form](/docs/form)'s `control`. Supports single or multiple files via the `multiple` prop.

## Example

<ComponentCodePreview
  component={<FormFileBasic />}
  filePath="app/docs/form-file/form-file-basic.tsx"
  classNameComponentContainer="p-8"
/>

## Component API

### FormFileInput

| Prop        | Type            | Description                                    |
| :----------- | :--------------- | :-------------------------------------------------- |
| control       | `Control<T>`      | The `control` object from `useForm()`                |
| name          | `FieldPath<T>`    | The field name, type-checked against `T`             |
| label         | string            | Field label                                          |
| description   | string            | Helper text below the drop zone                       |
| accept        | string            | Accepted file extensions/MIME types                   |
| multiple      | boolean           | Whether more than one file can be selected (default: `false`) |
| className     | string            | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper            |


import ComponentCodePreview from "@/components/app/component-code-preview"
import { generateMetadata } from "../utils/metadata"
import { FormArrayFieldBasic } from "./form-array-field-basic"

export const metadata = generateMetadata(
  "Form Array Field",
  "A repeatable list of inputs bound to react-hook-form's useFieldArray, with automatic error display."
)

# Form Array Field

A repeatable list of text inputs, backed by react-hook-form's [`useFieldArray`](https://react-hook-form.com/docs/usefieldarray). Unlike the other field components, it manages its own `Controller`-free subscription internally rather than taking a single `name`/`Controller` pair, since it renders a variable number of inputs.

## Example

<ComponentCodePreview
  component={<FormArrayFieldBasic />}
  filePath="app/docs/form-array-field/form-array-field-basic.tsx"
  classNameComponentContainer="p-8"
/>

## Component API

### FormArrayField

| Prop            | Type            | Description                              |
| :--------------- | :--------------- | :-------------------------------------------- |
| control            | `Control<T>`      | The `control` object from `useForm()`          |
| name               | `FieldPath<T>`    | The array field's name, type-checked against `T` |
| label              | string            | Field label                                     |
| description        | string            | Helper text below the list                      |
| placeholder        | string            | Placeholder for each item's input (default: `"Enter item"`) |
| addButtonLabel     | string            | Label for the add-item button (default: `"Add Item"`) |
| className          | string            | Additional CSS classes on the field wrapper       |


## Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/codezuma/pac-ui): Source code and issues
- [Installation Guide](https://pac.chandresh.dev/docs/installation): Detailed installation instructions
- [Component Documentation](https://pac.chandresh.dev/docs): Complete component API documentation
- [shadcn/ui Documentation](https://ui.shadcn.com): Documentation for the underlying UI component system
- [React Hook Form Documentation](https://react-hook-form.com): Documentation for the form state library Pac UI is built on
- [Zod Documentation](https://zod.dev): Documentation for the schema validation library Pac UI is built on
- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs): Documentation for the Next.js framework
- [Tailwind CSS Documentation](https://tailwindcss.com/docs): Documentation for the Tailwind CSS framework
